name: W9 Leave requests against remaining balances (Capture)
description: Read the remaining leave per employee, review each pending request in its pop-up, approve it when enough days are left (updating the balance) or decline it with a note, then check the dashboard. Web steps use captured objects (recorded with OOA Capture) instead of typed selectors where the element is fixed.
